defense_news.title: Trump orders Pentagon to cut back military exercises with South Korea
defense_news.summary: President Trump instructed the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with long-term Asian ally South Korea.

defense_news.title: US Space Force, Japan launch sensor to bolster space surveillance above Indo-Pacific
defense_news.summary: In a bilateral space effort, the U.S. Space Force successfully launched a Space Domain Awareness payload aboard Japan’s Quasi-Zenith Satellite 7.

defense_news.title: US awards Raytheon $22.9 billion deal to boost Tomahawk output
defense_news.summary: The U.S. military, scrambling to rebuild depleted stocks of high-tech weaponry, awarded Raytheon $22.9 billion to dramatically boost Tomahawk production.

defense_news.title: ‘Everybody loves a winner’: US-Ukraine intel sharing surges as Kyiv racks up wins
defense_news.summary: U.S. intelligence sharing with Ukraine has rebounded to full strength as Kyiv’s mid- and deep-range strikes continue to hammer Russia’s oil industry.
